title: From Ed 'Too Tall' Jones to Shedeur Shaders: Mapping HBCU players in the NFL

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: From Ed 'Too Tall' Jones to Shedeur Shaders: Mapping HBCU players in the NFL
sources.description: The NFL is hosting a HBCU Showcase ahead of the 2026 NFL draft. Shedeur Sanders and Travis Hunter are two of hundreds of NFL players who played at HBCUs.
